_about: Every word the game shows, by key. {placeholders} are filled by the core. Written by the agent; listed for the person in SECOND-ORDER.md.
title: Ravnica Digest
title.tagline: Walk Ravnica's grid, draw what each district holds, and build a deck that can face Niv-Mizzet or stop Rakdos.
title.notice: Ravnica Digest is unofficial Fan Content permitted under the Fan Content Policy. Not approved or endorsed by Wizards. Portions of the materials used are property of Wizards of the Coast. ©Wizards of the Coast LLC.
starter.heading: Choose your {guild} deck
starter.text: Each deck is twelve cards of this region. All but the first follow a deck Wizards of the Coast sold for the guild.
starter.Azorius.first.sub: This game's own deck: fliers and detain.
starter.Azorius.advance.sub: After the Return to Ravnica intro pack (2012): fliers and detain, led by the Archon of the Triumvirate.
starter.Azorius.ascendant.sub: After the Dissension theme deck (2006): fliers above all.
starter.Azorius.authority.sub: After the Dragon's Maze intro pack (2013): detain and walls until the fliers win.
starter.Azorius.kit.sub: After the Ravnica Allegiance Guild Kit (2019): cheap fliers behind a counterspell and a Detention Sphere.
starter.Azorius.dovin.sub: After the Ravnica Allegiance planeswalker deck (2019): tap and detain blockers, then the Sphinx of the Chimes.
starter.Izzet.first.sub: This game's own deck: weirds, spells and burn.
starter.Izzet.ingenuity.sub: After the Return to Ravnica intro pack (2012): Goblin Electromancer, Guttersnipe and the Hypersonic Dragon.
starter.Izzet.gizmometry.sub: After the Guildpact theme deck (2006): gadgets, weirds and a Volatile Rig.
starter.Izzet.duel.sub: After the Izzet half of Duel Decks: Izzet vs. Golgari (2012): cheap spells that grow the Nivmagus Elemental.
starter.Izzet.kit.sub: After the Guilds of Ravnica Guild Kit (2018): instants and sorceries, with the Mercurial Chemister.
starter.Izzet.ral.sub: After the Guilds of Ravnica planeswalker deck (2018): mostly creatures, with burn behind them.
starter.Rakdos.first.sub: This game's own deck: unleash and early attacks.
starter.Rakdos.raid.sub: After the Return to Ravnica intro pack (2012): unleash, led by the Carnival Hellsteed.
starter.Rakdos.wrack.sub: After the Return to Ravnica event deck (2012): fast attackers and removal, with Dreadbore.
starter.Rakdos.bloodsport.sub: After the Dissension theme deck (2006): fast attackers that empty their hand.
starter.Rakdos.revelry.sub: After the Dragon's Maze intro pack (2013): unleash, and the Chaos Imps.
starter.Rakdos.kit.sub: After the Ravnica Allegiance Guild Kit (2019): small attackers and removal.
starter.Golgari.first.sub: This game's own deck: scavenge and rot.
starter.Golgari.growth.sub: After the Return to Ravnica intro pack (2012): scavenge and counters, led by the Corpsejack Menace.
starter.Golgari.creep.sub: After the Return to Ravnica event deck (2012): scavenge and removal, with the Lotleth Troll.
starter.Golgari.deathcreep.sub: After the Ravnica: City of Guilds theme deck (2005): creatures that feed on the graveyard.
starter.Golgari.kit.sub: After the Guilds of Ravnica Guild Kit (2018): insects and the graveyard, with Abrupt Decay.
starter.Golgari.vraska.sub: After the Guilds of Ravnica planeswalker deck (2018): deathtouch and removal, led by Vraska the Unseen.
starter.Selesnya.first.sub: This game's own deck: creatures and tricks.
starter.Selesnya.surge.sub: After the Return to Ravnica intro pack (2012): creatures and combat tricks.
starter.Selesnya.united.sub: After the Ravnica: City of Guilds theme deck (2005): tokens, and populate to copy them.
starter.Selesnya.kit.sub: After the Guilds of Ravnica Guild Kit (2018): tokens, led by Trostani, Selesnya's Voice.
starter.Selesnya.tokens.sub: After the Starter Commander deck of 2022: tokens, with the Precinct Captain.
starter.Selesnya.zendikar.sub: After the green and white half of Duel Decks: Zendikar vs. Eldrazi (2015): big creatures and pump spells.
newgame.heading: Choose the guild you start with
newgame.text: Your guild offers six decks to start with, and gives you three lands in the Tenth District. Every other guild's cards can still be won.
guild.Azorius.sub: White and blue: fliers, detain, the law.
guild.Izzet.sub: Blue and red: spells, overload, experiments.
guild.Rakdos.sub: Black and red: haste, unleash, the show.
guild.Golgari.sub: Black and green: scavenge, deathtouch, rot.
guild.Selesnya.sub: Green and white: tokens, populate, the many.
story.opening: The Guildpact is gone, and the Tenth District holds its breath. Rumour in the plaza says Niv-Mizzet is testing something in Nivix, his aerie to the north-east. New Prahv keeps the writ that opens it.

city.rix.text: The Cult of Rakdos's cavern city, lit by its fires. Its armourer sells gear made for the show.
city.svogthos.text: The Golgari Swarm's guildhall, an old cathedral sunk into the undercity. Its armourer sells gear grown from bone.
hall.rix: Rakdos's court under the city. Performers post work here for anyone who will do it.
hall.svogthos: The Swarm's ossuary. Its keepers post work here for anyone who will do it.
error.not_in_hall: That quest is not posted in this hall. Look for it in its own city.
city.tenth.text: The plaza at the heart of the district. Every guild trades here, and none of them rules it.
city.prahv.text: The Azorius Senate's three towers. The clerks keep records of everything, including where Nivix's doors are.
city.vitu.text: The Conclave's great tree-city. The Selesnya welcome anyone who will plant something.
board.grew: New streets open beyond the edge.

mission.heading: Choose your mission
mission.text: Each mission is a game of its own, saved in place of the last.
mission.dracogenius.sub: Get the writ from New Prahv, climb Nivix and face Niv-Mizzet, at your own pace.
mission.riot.sub: Rakdos is marching on New Prahv, razing the tiles he walks over. Beat him before he gets there: the fewer steps you take, the better your grade.
riot.left: {n} moves from New Prahv, one move every {every} steps of yours
riot.moved: Rakdos moves on and razes the tile. He is {n} moves from New Prahv.
riot.fell: Rakdos reaches New Prahv. The Senate's doors come down to the beat of his drums, and the Azorius district burns.
riot.beaten: Rakdos is beaten in {steps} steps: grade {grade}.
riot.won.heading: Rakdos falls: grade {grade}
riot.won.text: You beat the Lord of Riots in {steps} steps. New Prahv stands, and the cult goes home to Rix Maadi to sulk.
riot.lost.heading: New Prahv has fallen
riot.lost.text: Rakdos razed the Azorius district before you could stop him. Start the Riot again to try for a grade.
riot.met: Rakdos stops his parade to look down at you. His minions laugh, and the drums keep time.
riot.odds: Rakdos brings {life} life and a {deck}-card deck. You have {lands} lands within Reach.
riot.slowed: The calliope is silent, and Rakdos's parade loses its beat: he now moves once every {n} of your steps.
riot.weakened: The Lyev Column's arresters mark Rakdos: he will bring {n} less life to your fight.
riot.minion_text: {card} holds this razed tile for Rakdos. His minions fight harder than the creatures met on the road.
place.calliope.text: A steam organ on a wagon plays the riot's march. The whole quarter dances to it.
place.column.text: An arresters' post of the Azorius Senate. Its lantern marks the lawbreakers the arresters are hunting.
